llm_verdict.message:
The rule has been remediated:

- Runtime: `net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects` set to 0.
- Persistent file `/etc/sysctl.d/99-disable-accept-redirects.conf` added with `net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0`.

This disables accepting ICMP redirects for all IPv4 interfaces and makes the setting survive reboots.
